# AI Image Generator & Editor with Automated Delivery

This workflow handles BOTH text-to-image generation AND image editing through a single webhook endpoint.

## How It Works:
1. User submits request via webhook (with or without image)
2. Workflow automatically detects if image was uploaded
3. Routes to appropriate AI processing path
4. Generates/edits image using Gemini 2.5 Flash
5. Uploads result to Google Drive
6. Sends professional email with download link

## Two Processing Modes:
- TEXT ONLY: Creates new images from descriptions
- TEXT + IMAGE: Edits uploaded images based on instructions

## Setup Requirements:
- OpenRouter API key (Gemini 2.5 Flash access)
- Google Drive credentials
- Email sending capability
- Active n8n instance

Replace the OpenRouter API key in BOTH Nano nodes with your own key.
Update Google Drive folder ID to your own folder.
Customize email template with your branding.

## Smart Routing Logic

This node checks: "Did the user upload an image?"

IF YES (image exists):
→ Goes to IMAGE EDITING path
→ Extracts image, formats it, sends to AI with prompt

IF NO (text only):
→ Goes to TEXT-TO-IMAGE path
→ Sends prompt directly to AI to generate new image

Both paths merge back together after AI processing for unified file handling and email delivery.

## Image Editing Path (When Image Uploaded)

1. EXTRACT FROM FILE
   - Converts uploaded binary file to base64 text
   - This makes the image readable by the AI

2. CODE NODE
   - Formats base64 as proper data URL
   - Format: "data:image/png;base64,[base64string]"
   - Required for Gemini API consumption

3. NANO NODE
   - Sends both image URL and text prompt to AI
   - AI understands what to change in the image
   - Returns edited image as base64

This path handles: product edits, background changes, style transfers, object additions/removals

## CRITICAL: Update Your API Key!

Both "Nano" nodes use OpenRouter to access Gemini 2.5 Flash.

YOU MUST:
1. Get API key from openrouter.ai
2. Replace the existing key in BOTH nodes
3. Add credits to your OpenRouter account

Current model: google/gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview

To change:
- Click on either Nano node
- Change model name in JSON body
- See openrouter.ai/docs for available vision models

Cost: ~$0.01-0.05 per image (varies by model)

## Converting AI Response to Usable File

AI returns images as base64 encoded strings embedded in JSON.

EDIT FIELDS NODE:
- Extracts the base64 image data
- Separates the MIME type (image/png)
- Prepares for file conversion

CONVERT TO FILE NODE:
- Transforms base64 text into actual binary image
- Creates proper file format (.png)
- Now ready for upload to storage

This is necessary because Google Drive needs binary files, not base64 text.

## Cloud Storage & Link Generation

UPLOAD FILE:
- Saves image to your Google Drive folder
- File name format: UserName_timestamp.png
- Prevents duplicate names with timestamp
- Update folder ID to YOUR Google Drive folder!

SHARE FILE:
- Makes file publicly accessible (read-only)
- Generates shareable download link
- Required so users can download without Google login
- Link stays active as long as file exists

IMPORTANT: Replace the folder ID with your own!
Current: 1OVbIh09p4NDtoZnMOce7yD2bmF7EOdvl

## Professional Email Notification

Sends responsive HTML email with:
- Personalized greeting using user's name
- Direct download link to generated image
- 7-day expiration warning (customizable)
- Social sharing buttons for viral growth
- Referral program messaging
- Mobile-responsive design

CUSTOMIZE:
- Change sender name/email
- Update social media links
- Modify referral rewards
- Adjust branding colors
- Add your logo

The email template is production-ready but fully customizable in the HTML field.

## User Confirmation Response

Immediately returns success message to user:
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Your request was received and is being processed. 
              Please check your email for the final result."
}

This happens BEFORE image processing completes, so users don't wait.

The actual image arrives via email 30-90 seconds later.

You can customize this message or add tracking IDs.

## Ways to Extend This Workflow

ADD PAYMENT/CREDITS:
- Insert node after webhook to check user credits
- Only process if user has remaining quota
- Deduct credits after successful generation

ADD USAGE TRACKING:
- Log requests to database
- Track generation counts per user
- Monitor popular prompt types

MULTIPLE AI MODELS:
- Add dropdown for model selection
- Route to different AI nodes based on choice
- Offer "fast/standard/premium" tiers

WATERMARKING:
- Add image manipulation node
- Apply watermark to free tier users
- Remove for paid subscribers

WEBHOOKS FOR NOTIFICATIONS:
- Send to Slack/Discord when image ready
- Post to social media automatically
- Trigger other automation workflows

## Webhook Entry Point

This receives requests from your form/API with these fields:
- Full Name: User's name (required)
- Your Email: Where to send results (required)
- Requested edit: What to create/change (required)
- Your_Image_Here0: Optional uploaded image file

The workflow automatically detects if an image was uploaded and routes accordingly.

You can replace this with a Form Trigger for easier testing.

Example POST body:
{
  "Full Name": "John Doe",
  "Your Email": "john@example.com",
  "Requested edit": "A robot in a garden",
  "Your_Image_Here0": [binary file data]
}

## Common Issues & Solutions

"No image generated"
→ Check OpenRouter API key is correct in BOTH Nano nodes
→ Verify you have credits in OpenRouter account

"Email not received"
→ Check spam folder
→ Verify email credentials are set up
→ Test email node separately

"File not in Google Drive"
→ Confirm Google Drive credentials connected
→ Check folder ID matches your actual folder
→ Verify folder permissions

"Webhook not responding"
→ Ensure workflow is activated (toggle at top)
→ Check webhook URL is correct
→ Verify API key if authentication enabled

"Image looks wrong"
→ AI interpretation issue - try more specific prompts
→ For edits: ensure uploaded image is clear/high quality

## Text-to-Image Generation Path (No Image Uploaded)

NANO: PROMPT ONLY
- Receives only text description
- No reference image needed
- AI generates completely new image from scratch
- Uses same Gemini 2.5 Flash model

Example prompts that work well:
- "A sunset over mountains with purple sky"
- "Modern minimalist logo for coffee shop"
- "Futuristic city with flying cars, cyberpunk style"
- "Product mockup of blue water bottle on wooden table"

Output merges with image editing path for unified processing.
